title: Copilot Studio: MCP-compliant tools in agents and workflows
summary: Hold: the credential-control instructions omit the required environment-group route, and the tool-confirmation path omits Additional details. Credit-consumption reporting has a documented API despite being marked undocumented, and the licensing exception needs its authenticated-identity condition. Absence of a classic data policy also does not establish that any compatible server is allowed.

claims.quote:
Resources: File-like data that an agent can read for more context, such as API responses or file contents
- Tools: Functions that a language model can call to perform an action
- Prompts: Predefined prompt templates to accomplish specific tasks
